description: One company's registry events, each confirmed against the publication's own UID.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 100; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

since.description: Start of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 365 days ago; ranges wider than 365 days are trimmed to the newest 365 days.

uid.description: The company's Swiss UID, in the form CHE-XXX.XXX.XXX (spaces, dots and dashes are stripped and the check digit is verified).

until.description: End of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: swissco_events
